thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency spike detected on streaming endpoints in us-west-2. p95 ~1.8x, p99 ~3.6x baseline. Error rate stable. Marking sev2. Auto-metrics: KV cache eviction rate up 4x, slab fragmentation up, prefill vs decode imbalance detected.

alice_h: saw this, I'm on it. collecting dashboards now. any immediate customer impact?

ben_s: customers reporting longer streaming stalls for multi-turn chat (dropouts ~>5s). Support flagged two enterprise tenants seeing degraded response times.

carol_m: heap: kv-slot-usage shows a bunch of small hot keys causing slabs to fragment. eviction count spiked at 13:02 UTC. prefill queue length >> decode queue length (~2.4x).

alice_h: can you paste the eviction log tail?

carol_m: ```logs
[13:01:58] slab_alloc: shard=3 slot_sz=64 evict_count=122
[13:02:10] prefill_enqueue: id=svc-rt-45 queue_len=210
[13:02:11] decode_worker: id=svc-rt-45 backlog=85
[13:02:30] eviction: reason=slab_compact triggered_by=slot_pressure
```

dan_oncall: interesting that decode backlog is lower but still seeing stalls — suggests prefill is flooding certain shards and causing eviction churn while decoders wait for KV fetches — classic prefill vs decode imbalance.

eve_prodops: immediate mitigations: 1) enable per-shard prefill throttling (config flag) 2) temporary increase kv_cache_size on affected nodes 3) route heavy tenants to us-east-1. Which do we want as quick actions?

alice_h: prioritize config toggles we can flip without deploy. ben, can you open a partial customer-impact note? mention enterprise tenants A and B.

ben_s: opened support ticket and notified account teams. ETA for public status update ~30m after mitigation.

carol_m: I can flip prefill throttling via runtime flag: `service.runtime.prefill_throttle=0.6` (60% of baseline). This should reduce enqueue pressure. I'd also reduce per-request prefetch window from 8->4 tokens for streaming sessions.

alice_h: go ahead and flip prefill throttle. dan, can you coordinate a fast config roll for the decode workers to reduce prefetch? we want low-risk changes.

dan_oncall: applying throttle now (doing config push to shard pool 3,4,5). Monitoring logs.

deploy-bot: config-change: service.runtime.prefill_throttle updated on pool shards [3,4,5] by dan_oncall at 13:05:12 UTC.

carol_m: seeing eviction rate drop ~40% within 1m of change, prefill queue length falling. p95 trending back toward baseline. p99 still elevated but moving.

alice_h: good. next: should we route tenant A to us-east-1 as a precaution? that requires temporary DNS reroute via traffic-gateway. eve_prodops, can ops do a quick reroute for two tenant subnets?

eve_prodops: can do; I'll move tenant A to edge-west->us-east pool (carry up to 10% extra load). Preparing change, will post when done.

support-bot: Tenant A & B notified of mitigation in progress.

carol_m: note: we should schedule a defrag job for slab allocator; fragmentation index currently 0.72 on several hosts. Suggest staggered defrag during off-peak (2h window).

alice_h: Agreed. After we stabilize, schedule staggered defrag and follow-up postmortem. For now, monitor SLOs and handshake with support. Dan, handoff when you're done? I'm taking 14:00-15:30 UT break soon.

dan_oncall: I'll stay on until things look stable and then hand off to carol_m. Current metrics: p95 back to 1.2x, p99 down to 1.7x. eviction rate trending down.

eve_prodops: reroute for Tenant A complete. load shift ~8%, no errors reported.
\anice_h: (typo correction) alice_h: thanks team. running runbook: KV-PRESSURE-EMERGENCY. Please add any follow-ups to the incident doc.

ben_s: adding customer-impact notes and list of affected API keys in incident doc.

carol_m: leaving a quick remediation checklist: 1) Keep prefill_throttle at 0.6 for 30m, 2) schedule slab defrag on pool-3/4/5 overnight, 3) add per-tenant prefill rate limits, 4) investigate root cause of hot key patterns (client-side batching?).

alice_h: handoff to carol_m at 13:25 UTC. carol, you're primary for the next watch. I'll update postmortem owners.

carol_m: acknowledged. I'll continue monitoring p99 and queue metrics. Slack update to status page in 20m if stable.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (prefill throttling + tenant reroute). p95 and p99 improving; customer impact reduced to degraded (was degraded/partial outage). Next update in 20m or on status change.

alice_h: final note before break: we need a long-term fix — implement dynamic prefill backpressure tied to per-shard eviction signals + improved hot-key eviction policies (LRU vs frequency-aware). Add to backlog with priority P1.

carol_m: ack. adding tickets now. closing handoff.

support-bot: Customers A,B updated: "We're seeing intermittent higher latency earlier today; mitigation applied, monitoring continues."
_meta: generated for dataset: eng-sre slack thread about KV cache fragmentation, live mitigation, customer impact, and handoff
